entities.name: Economic Diversification and Climate Vulnerability
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Saint Lucia has worked to diversify beyond tourism and agriculture, developing financial services and creative industries. As a small island developing state, it faces existential threats from climate change, including intensifying hurricanes and sea-level rise, while advocating for climate justice
